correctness.rationale: The 16 Z-rX-sY and 12 coordinate-pair lines are 28 distinct geometric bitangents for every odd characteristic. Independent implementation in Z[T]/(T^4+1) computed all 3276 triple determinants: exactly 60 zero, all 3216 nonzero norms have prime support only 2,3,5,17, providing an infinite-prime no-new-concurrence certificate. Reconstructed pair intersections with independent Fp² arithmetic give the complete p=3,5,17 spectra (63 quadruples; 240 doubles+16 triples+15 quadruples; 144 doubles+48 triples+15 quadruples) and Frobenius-fixed counts for p=3,5,7,11,17,41. Pair counts equal C(28,2)=378 and the 16 interior plus 15 coordinate-zero F5 points exhaust P²(F5). Cyclotomic Galois maps determine all generic congruence classes p mod 8; no finite-sample inference for other primes.
residual_risks: The model counts geometric bitangent intersections after reduction; these are not quartic rational points. Characteristic 2 is excluded.
